name: Baked salmon with new potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Toss the potatoes with two thirds of the oil and roast for 20 minutes.
Push the potatoes aside, sit the salmon in the tray, rub with the rest of the oil, the garlic and seasoning.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until the salmon flakes at its thickest point.
Boil or steam the green beans for 4 minutes and add them to the tray.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and scatter with parsley before serving.

name: Cod with parsley sauce

ingredients.display: a good handful of parsley, chopped
salt, pepper and a grating of nutmeg

steps: Boil the potatoes for 18 minutes until tender, then drain and mash with a splash of the milk and a third of the butter.
Poach the cod in the remaining milk in a shallow pan for 7 to 8 minutes, covered, until it flakes. Lift it out and keep the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter in a small pan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the poaching milk a little at a time and simmer for 3 minutes until smooth and thick, then stir in the parsley and season.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes and serve everything with the sauce poured over the fish.

name: Grilled mackerel with salad
steps: Boil the new potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and halve any large ones.
Heat the grill to high, score the mackerel skin, season it and grill skin side up for 5 to 6 minutes until the skin crisps and the flesh is opaque.
Toss the leaves, tomatoes and cucumber with the olive oil, half the lemon juice and seasoning.
Loosen the horseradish with the rest of the lemon juice to make a dressing for the warm potatoes.
Serve the mackerel on the salad with the potatoes alongside.

name: Smoked haddock with poached egg

ingredients.display: black pepper and a grating of nutmeg

steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and toss with half the butter and pepper.
Poach the haddock in the milk in a shallow pan over a low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until it flakes; drain and discard the milk.
Wilt the spinach in the rest of the butter, season with nutmeg and press out any water.
Poach the egg in barely simmering water for 3 minutes so the yolk stays soft.
Pile the spinach on the plate, sit the haddock on top with the egg, and serve the potatoes alongside.
